children: Willow Lane Acquisition Corp. II reported net income for the third quarter, compared with a net loss in the prior-year period. Trust-account interest income of $1.36M was partly offset by $170,951 in general and administrative costs and $19,981 in compensation expense. The company remains focused on identifying a target for its initial business combination.
: Marketable securities in the trust account totaled $146.95M at September 30, 2026.
: The company is seeking businesses with established and growing revenue streams and has until February 17, 2028 to complete a combination.
: Cash outside the trust account was $1.17M, with a working capital surplus of $1.18M at September 30, 2026.
